pins.reply: hook is 1.4x larger (96 -> 132 px, wraps to 3 lines inside the safe area) and now reads 'Your phone is stealing your study hour.' (r2a) instead of the generic 'Most of us check our phone...'

detail.note: spend rows are wall-clock ms as recorded by the board

agentRun.agent: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) acting as the user's agent, CLI only (mgl via tsx), SKILL.md + docs/reference/board.md
agentRun.video: 11.5 s 1080x1920, calm "clean" style recoloured golden hour, hook "Your phone is stealing your study hour." at 132 px; 5 caption cues, music bed, CTA
friction: show prints only the LAST log line: the person's full answer (m2) was hidden behind my own say; I had to use `view` (truncated at 120 chars) or --json to read it
advice "answer it" is satisfied by any later ai message, so a say that races a human message marks it answered (m2/m3, m10/m11, m13/m14)
`mgl board render --level 3 --dry-run` silently rendered a 14 s draft: --dry-run is in the global flag list and render ignores it; there is no estimate-only mode
`mgl board render --help` prints the generic board guide, not render's options
level-2 sheet is not put on the board: the person never sees it unless the agent adds an image shape by hand
draft/final mp4s are not surfaced on the board (no video shape or link); I had to paste a /files URL into chat

options can only be visualised from the linked project: variants (calm, warm-gold, warm-dusk) needed forked project files, mgl render --still, image shapes and manual spend.add; the board does not know these renders
after the final render, next still says "climb to level 4 (final): open a round fidelity=4"; no done state
storyboard.make every=2s samples t=0, the first frame of the hook entrance: s1 is an empty background on the board
spend is wall-clock ms but labelled "CPU min": the final cost 25.9 s wall vs 63.8 s user+sys CPU
undo is one shared stack: `mgl board edit undo` by the agent removes the person's last op (verified on a copy with a human say)
history lines do not say who made each op
render level-1 footer "put options in a round" is printed even when the round is already decided
image shape label is not drawn in the snapshot; the snapshot shows no rounds/brief/chat, so the agent cannot check how options read to the person
node --import tsx <abs main.ts> fails outside the repo (tsx resolved from cwd); needed --import file:///.../tsx/dist/loader.mjs (dev-setup only)
agentRun.graderCaveat: grade 8/8 is inflated by the scripted person: it decides every proposed round within ~1 poll, never pushes back, and the graders only check form (option counts, word counts, a change-word regex), not whether the agent asked for consent before the level-3 spend.
